svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 07 · Riverside · 01/12 The Bell Tower (Legendary)
svg.desc: The carillon at the middle of campus. When it plays, the whole place slows down to listen. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
